spatial_flow_description: Place “任务输入” with “动态任务｜工具版本” at upper left and a separate “独立校准集” at upper right. Across the middle align four equally sized outlined stages: “R1 参数适配” with “任务证据”, “有限探测”, “低秩更新”; “R2 轨迹学习” with “执行核验”, “正确性与效用”, “加权训练池”; “R3 有界记忆” with “参数记忆”, “轨迹回放”, “冻结新策略”; and “R4 行动校准” with “执行前证据”, “独立校准”, “风险感知执行”. Route input into R1; connect R1→R2→R3→R4. The independent calibration set connects only to R4. Below place “冻结测试集” with “仅用于评价”, feeding a wide “评价输出” box reading “成功率｜遗忘｜风险覆盖率｜总成本”; R4 also feeds that box. A dashed outer return from R4 to input reads “下一轮可用日志”. The test box has no return to training. A footer band “累计资源约束” contains “计算｜附加参数｜记忆字节”.
caption_note: PACT-Agent总体研究框架。四路线共享证据定义与接口，训练、开发、校准和测试记录按用途隔离；所有适配器及证据获取成本均计入累计预算。
No measurements or pre-experiment results are rendered.
RENDERING_RULES_AND_NEGATIVE_PROMPT_INST: White canvas and WHITE box fills with COLORED BORDERS ONLY.
At most three blue chromatic colors plus neutrals.
Native structural rectangles, dividers and connectors only; every main block has a geometric anchor.
NO emojis, NO lock/fire/lightning decorative symbols, NO 3D rendering.
Dashed borders for frozen modules; dashed arrows for feedback or unverified mechanism.
No overall title, invented formulas, dimensions or performance numbers.
Readable simplified Chinese, no cropping or overlapping labels.
